sources.title: Urban Flood and Gully Erosion Risk Management in the Congo Basin: Republic of the Congo, Technical Report
sources.organization: Global Center on Adaptation and World Bank
sources.temporal_coverage: Urban hazard and pre-feasibility assessments; workshops and community demonstrations in October-November 2025.
sources.methodology: Technical report draws on an urban NbSWLM inventory, three site assessments and 2025 workshops.
sources.limitations: Proposed measures and workshop findings; not an impact evaluation or proof of implementation.

sources.title: Republic of the Congo: Multi-Year Strategy 2025-2027
sources.organization: United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees
sources.temporal_coverage: Situation analysis includes dated 2021-2024 displacement information; strategy period 2025-2027.
sources.methodology: UNHCR multi-year operational strategy and country situation analysis.
sources.limitations: Strategy commitments are not evaluated results; indexed excerpts do not expose PDF pagination.

sources.title: IFRC-DG ECHO Pilot Programmatic Partnership: Annual Overview 2024
sources.organization: International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies
sources.temporal_coverage: IFRC-DG ECHO Pilot Programmatic Partnership activities and reported results in 2024.
sources.methodology: Partnership annual overview reports operational results across participating National Societies.
sources.limitations: The Congo early-warning result is narrative and gives no location, count or evaluation method.

claims.locator: PDF pp. 9 and 13, sections 2.1 and 3.2, Site B risk context
claims.paraphrase: In Brazzaville's Tsieme catchment, runoff-fed active gullies at Ngambio and Itsali in Mfilou threaten nearby homes and infrastructure; at Ngambio, erosion continues despite existing channels.
claims.limitations: Site-specific pre-feasibility findings, not a citywide exposure inventory.

claims.locator: PDF pp. 9 and 11, sections 2.1 and feasibility decision tree
claims.paraphrase: Exposed informal settlements, undersized drainage and catchment degradation amplify flood and erosion impacts; where land tenure is unclear, the report advises conflict-sensitive consultation and due diligence before works.
claims.limitations: Planning guidance, not evidence of conflict outcomes.
claims.source_stated_fcv_link: It prescribes conflict-sensitive consultation when land tenure is unclear for proposed risk-reduction works.

claims.locator: PDF pp. 16 and 29, technical lessons and Stage 1 feasibility screen
claims.paraphrase: November 2025 demonstrations observed sediment trapped by bamboo check-dams, considered locally replicable; site screening weighs security, institutions and social tensions.
geographies: Republic of Congo urban priority sites
claims.limitations: Demonstrations and guidance, not long-term impact evidence.
claims.source_stated_fcv_link: The screen treats security, institutions and tensions as constraints on climate-adaptation feasibility and community maintenance.

claims.locator: PDF p. 9, section 2.1, floodplain and coastal-fluvial exposure in Pointe-Noire
claims.paraphrase: At Pointe-Noire's Tchikobo-Songolo corridor, project screening found high susceptibility to adjacent coastal floods and fluvial flooding intensified by rainfall runoff.
claims.limitations: Pre-feasibility susceptibility screening, not measured losses.

claims.locator: Situation Analysis, paragraphs on refugee-hosting areas and climate hazards; PDF pagination not exposed in indexed excerpt
claims.paraphrase: As of 30 September 2024, UNHCR counted 71,122 refugees and asylum-seekers; 80% lived rurally, with arrivals in Likouala and Pool. It says host areas lack services and face climate-hazard vulnerability and limited adaptation.
institutions: Government of the Republic of Congo
claims.limitations: Dated national totals and area-level descriptions; no hazard-specific local exposure estimates.
claims.source_stated_fcv_link: UNHCR says climate-hazard vulnerability and limited adaptation affect both displaced people and host populations in hosting areas.

claims.locator: 2025-2027 strategy, paragraphs on resilience, emergency response and community participation; PDF pagination not exposed in indexed excerpt
claims.paraphrase: UNHCR's 2025-2027 strategy plans to maintain emergency response capacity and resilience to climate shocks, while strengthening local integration, participation and social cohesion.
institutions: Government of the Republic of Congo
claims.limitations: These are strategy objectives, not achieved or evaluated results.
claims.source_stated_fcv_link: UNHCR links civil and community participation with ownership, accountability and social cohesion.

claims.locator: Situation Analysis, paragraph on socioeconomic integration and climate effects; PDF pagination not exposed in indexed excerpt
claims.paraphrase: UNHCR says climate-change effects exacerbate economic weaknesses affecting refugee inclusion; health, water and sanitation services are full, and food insecurity constrains refugees' access to essentials.
institutions: Government of the Republic of Congo
claims.limitations: The strategy does not quantify climate-attributable economic or food-security pressures.
claims.source_stated_fcv_link: UNHCR says climate effects exacerbate economic weaknesses limiting refugee socioeconomic inclusion.

claims.locator: Annual Overview, IFRC-DG ECHO Pilot Programmatic Partnership, printed p. 89
claims.paraphrase: IFRC reports that a community flood early-warning system in the Republic of Congo prompted preventive action, with most people relocating to safer areas after receiving alerts.
claims.limitations: Narrative result gives no local site, count, denominator or evaluation method.

access_audit.notes: Opened 33-page publisher PDF and inspected urban hazard, named-site, feasibility, workshop and implementation material.
access_audit.reuse_terms: Publisher page states CC BY-NC-ND 4.0; no source text reproduced and adapted content reuse was not assumed open.

search_audit.query: Republic of Congo climate urban flood gully erosion subnational vulnerability Brazzaville Pointe-Noire report
search_audit.outcome: Opened the GCA-WB 2025 technical report with named sites in Mfilou and Pointe-Noire and read its relevant pages; existing IMF evidence already covered 2023-2024 national flood impacts.

search_audit.query: Republic of Congo climate change conflict refugees land tenure resource competition climate security
search_audit.outcome: Found UNHCR evidence that refugee-hosting areas face climate-hazard vulnerability amid service/adaptation gaps and GCA guidance on conflict-sensitive land-tenure consultation; no evidence found that climate hazards cause violence in Congo.

search_audit.query: Republic of Congo Pool conflict displacement insecurity limits climate adaptation service delivery report
search_audit.outcome: GCA's feasibility screen treats security, institutional presence and social tensions as constraints on climate-site selection and community maintenance. A World Bank PAD/CPF search result was excluded after its PDF showed restricted-distribution markings; no source-safe evidence of conflict effects on climate adaptation was identified beyond feasibility guidance.

search_audit.query: Republic of Congo community early warning flood response resilience adaptation refugees host communities 2025
search_audit.outcome: IFRC reports a community flood early-warning system and preventive relocation; UNHCR sets planned climate-shock response and inclusion objectives, while GCA documents workshop-tested local measures and enabling conditions.

gaps: No source-safe, country-specific evidence located that climate hazards cause violence or conflict in the Republic of Congo; the reported tenure link concerns conflict-sensitive design of proposed flood-risk works.
The current official UNHCR strategy and IFRC result were available only as indexed publisher excerpts; direct PDF access failed, and exact UNHCR PDF pagination remains unavailable.
The GCA report describes pre-feasibility designs, workshop observations and demonstration results, not implemented citywide programs or long-term outcomes.
A World Bank appraisal document and CPF found in searches were excluded from claims because their PDF covers contain FOR OFFICIAL USE ONLY/restricted-distribution notices.
Existing NDC and flood-impact estimates in the baseline remain dated; no newly inspected post-2024 event inventory or subnational climate-conflict assessment was found.
